thread:
emma: Heads up — Lynx Health is asking for our penetration test evidence + vuln scan outputs and a remediation cadence they can share with their vendor risk team. They want a single package (report PDFs, raw scan CSV, triage ticket list) by EOD Thursday. Anyone blocked on exporting artifacts?

raj: I can grab the artifacts from the security-drive and generate the CSV of raw findings. planning to include: vuln id, severity, affected component, status, remediation owner, ticket link. will push to the secure share. :white_check_mark:

sarah: We should confirm whether they want the full report or redacted. legal flagged internal hostnames, staff emails, and internal-only screenshots. i'd err on redacted + an attestation note that full report was produced for internal review.

mike: Agreed on redaction. Legal suggested strip private ips and replace with <redacted>. i can run the redact script and produce two bundles: (1) redacted package for vendor risk, (2) full package for SOC review (share via SSO link). script i use:

```bash
git clone git@repo:redwood/sec-tools.git
cd sec-tools/redaction
./redact-report.sh --input s3://redwood-pen-tests/lynx-2026-03-10 --output /tmp/lynx-redacted
```

raj: perfect. i'll also produce the CSV and include ticket references (JIRA). will create an index.md that outlines mapping from finding -> fix owner -> ETA.

devsec-bot: Pen test archive for lynx-2026-03-10 has been copied to secure-share:/vendor-evidence/lynx/1768469123/ by raj. Access logs recorded.

emma: Quick checklist for final package we send to Lynx: redacted report PDF, raw scan CSV, triage ticket list (links), remediation timeline (week-by-week), short attestation statement, point of contact (we should name a single engineer). Also include a brief note on mitigations we recommend (config changes, patch version targets).

mike: Can someone own the remediation timeline graphic? i'll do the redaction + attest. raj take CSV + ticket links. emma can you be POC?

emma: I can be POC for vendor. happy to own comms. i'll confirm any NDA constraints with legal and loop them in if they need to sign before we send.

sarah: For timeline: suggest 3 buckets — critical (0-2 weeks), high (2-6 weeks), medium/low (6-12 weeks). assign tentative owners now and lock after engineering triage. i'll draft the week-by-week and post here for review.

raj: posted draft CSV to secure-share:/vendor-evidence/lynx/drafts/1768469123/findings.csv (permission: sales@redwood + lynx-security). ping me if access issues.

mike: i started redaction; replacing staff names & internal dashboards. sample redaction command i used:

```bash
sed -E 's/[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+/<redacted-ip>/g' report.html > report-redacted.html
```

emma: Legal says we also need a short attestation: "Redwood Inference attests that the artifacts provided are derived from the engagement dated 2026-03-10 and are representative of the security findings. Certain internal identifiers have been redacted for confidentiality." I'll paste exact wording once legal confirms.

sarah: FYI Lynx asked specifically for SCA (software composition analysis) SBOM outputs and which CVEs were open vs. fixed. raj — can you include SBOM CSV and mapping to CVE list?

raj: yes — SBOM exported and included as sbom_lynx.csv. mapping table columns: package, version, cve, status, ticket. added in the same folder.

devsec-bot: Vulnerability export completed: sbom_lynx.csv, findings.csv, tickets_export.json uploaded to secure-share:/vendor-evidence/lynx/1768469123/ at 2026-03-13T18:02:03Z.

mike: OK timeline owner assignments (tentative):
- critical: raj (0-2w)
- high: sarah (2-6w)
- medium/low: eng-pool (6-12w)
I'll update index.md with these owners and link to tickets.

emma: Great. Action items and deadlines:
- mike: finish redaction and produce redacted PDF by 2026-03-14 10:00 PT
- raj: finalize CSV + SBOM mapping + JIRA links by 2026-03-14 12:00 PT
- sarah: draft week-by-week remediation timeline + owners by 2026-03-14 12:00 PT
- emma: confirm with legal and send package to Lynx security by 2026-03-14 16:00 PT

mike: noted, will deliver. :thumbsup:

sarah: will review owners once tickets are attached. expect my update by noon.

emma: Thanks team — i'll update customer and mark as 'waiting on redwood package'. If anything blocks, post here and tag me. :eyes:
